progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on D in Dozarbi Mansuri, Mansuri. The line peaks at Ak4 (411.7 Hz) at 0:52.8. It closes on Ek3, not the tonic (B3 → G4 → G4 → Ak4 → Ek4 → Ek3).
